Nonheterantherous stamens do not imply globally integrated architecture: S. lycocarpum is andromonoecious, with hermaphroditic and functionally male flowers. Hermaphroditic flowers produce more pollen and fruit; staminate flowers show higher pollen viability and sterile ovules. Control-side pollen-reward versus gamete conflict remains unresolved, but architecture is coded as among-flower module division rather than shared integration.
